_comment: Creature Burn (2026-11-20, Stage 2 batch 3). Teetering Peaks' land POSITION: the opponent is at 8, we have
three untapped Mountains and hold Ball Lightning + Teetering Peaks. Played first, Peaks has no creature to
target (the trigger is removed, CR 603.3d) and Ball Lightning swings for 6 -- the opponent survives. Cast
Ball Lightning FIRST, then play Peaks (Plan::land_slot 1, counted by TurnSolver::LandSlotCounts: a haste
creature cast), and the trigger gives it +2/+0: 8 trample damage, a turn-3 win. Unfindable before batch 3
(with no landfall watcher every plan played its land first).
